1) The management of firm level technological resources is a key to achieve superior performance in dynamic environments; 2) The management of patent portfolio is a key to the success of the management of firm technological resources; 3) Different types of patent portfolios require different approaches to achieve superior firm performances in dynamic environments; and 4) Different types of portfolios have different impacts on firm performances in dynamic environment.
different types of firm patent portfolios have different characteristics and different strategic approaches should applied to manage them.
the management of firm patent portfolios can be classified into different types and that different types of portfolio should be managed in different ways to achieve superior firm's performance.

the strategic approaches for a new typology of firm patent portfolios in dynamic environments.
the management of patent portfolios and their impact on the performance of firms in uncertain environments.
the strategic approaches to manage firm level resources to achieve superior firm value in uncertain environments.

the patent portfolio management is a strategic issue for the companies, and the management of the portfolio is a strategic tool to achieve competitive advantage in dynamic environments.
the management of patent portfolios should be a key component of the firm's strategy.
a firm's patent portfolio should be considered as an important strategic resource that can create value for the firm.

firms need to manage their patent portfolios in order to create value and achieve superior performance in the long and short run.
the patent portfolios should be managed according to their types and the characteristics of each patent portfolio type.
firms should manage their patent portfolios in a way to maximize their synergistic economic values.

firms should develop their patent portfolios according to the strategic approach that best suits their business model and the characteristics of the industry in which they operate.
the strategic management of patent portfolios is an important source of value for the firms.
